question: What absurd consequence follows if śakti were considered impure?
premises: Śakti is identified with the deity
Impurity attributed to śakti would transfer to the deity
inference: If she were impure, then the deity would also be impure.
uncertainties: Whether deva is vocative or part of the argument
plain_english: O Goddess, if she were impure, then the deity would also be impure.
